Prop_sakura_schoolyard_SchoolBuilding.notes: Budget 6000. 3 storeys, 36 front/back + 12 side windows, clock gable with pink pediment, entrance canopy, roof fence. No change after look.

Prop_pirate_harbor_SkullRock.notes: Budget 6000. Faceted stone skull, ink sockets/nose/cave mouth, white teeth, pirate flag with orange band. No change after look.

Prop_ninja_village_NinjaHouse.notes: Domed green roof with rooftop water tank, round ink windows in dark rings, round swirl sign over the door. No change after look.

Prop_ninja_village_TreeHouse.notes: Width/depth -10%/-11% (canopy kept compact). Green = rail and hut roof. No change after look.

Prop_shared_LuckyCat.notes: Shared trim: yellow (bell, koban, tassel band) + white body. Raised paw is the cat's right (+X). Depth +11%. Changed after the group sheet: slanted eye bars read as an angry scowl -> tilted the other way (friendly).

Prop_shared_RamenStand.notes: Shared trim: yellow (noodles, wheel hubs, cart band) + white (noren marks, bowl rim, egg, steam). Changed after look: height +17% -> roof/bowl lowered 0.7, posts and chopsticks shortened -> +4%.

Prop_pirate_harbor_FishStall.notes: Changed after look: awning hid the fish crates from the 3/4 view -> front edge raised 6.4 -> 7.4 so crates show; then 4056 tris -> two fish per crate. Octopus + blue fish hang on white lines.

Prop_ninja_village_FoxStatue.notes: Changed after look: width +21% (tail fan) -> fan +-62 -> +-46 deg, tails shorter -> -2%. Five tails, green tips.

Prop_ninja_village_GiantShuriken.notes: Width -11% (point spread). White keyline star proud of both faces, green ribbon ring round the hub. No change after look.

Prop_pirate_harbor_GiantAnchor.notes: Ink iron anchor, orange stock caps/bands/fluke studs, sand rope helix + ground coil. No change after look.

Prop_shared_VendingMachine.notes: Shared trim: white window + top band, yellow cans/buttons. 'Glowing' is white albedo only (no emissive in a flat-colour mesh): set Material=Neon on the White part in Studio if a glow is wanted. Depth +14% (cans stand proud). No change after look.

Prop_shared_KoiFlagPole.notes: Changed after look: width +23% -> carp streamers shortened (4.9/4.4/3.9 -> 3.9/3.5/3.1) -> +7%. Carp eyes are white only (no ink pupil: would be a 6th colour).

Prop_shared_LanternString.notes: Seven lanterns alternating red/white, yellow caps and finials. No change after look.

Prop_shared_Daruma.notes: One eye painted (solid ink), the other blank (ink ring, white centre). Reads a little owl-like at distance. No change after look.

Prop_shared_DangoStatue.notes: Pink/white/green balls on a yellow skewer, yellow plinth band. No change after look.

Prop_sakura_schoolyard_BasketballHoop.notes: Pink backing frame + pink target square, red rim, white net (radial wall 0.4). No change after look.

Prop_sakura_schoolyard_SakuraArch.notes: Height +9% (top blossom). 9 lobes on the arch, 4 on the posts, 5 petal piles. No change after look.

Prop_sakura_schoolyard_BikeRack.notes: Changed after look: height -16% and frames too thin to show colour -> taller bikes, frame tubes 0.4 -> 0.54, seats in bike colour, loops pulled in (width 10.3 -> 9.3). 3982 tris (budget 4000).

Prop_pirate_harbor_TreasurePile.notes: Changed after look: height +38% -> lid laid back 100 -> 128 deg, chest lowered; then found the faceted heap lobe dipped 1.65 below y=0 and grounding lifted everything -> flat-bottomed revolved mound -> height -8%.

Prop_pirate_harbor_Cannon.notes: Muzzle at -Z, barrel pitched up 8 deg, orange muzzle ring + 2 bands, cannonball pyramid at -X. Width +11%. No change after look.

Prop_ninja_village_ScrollStand.notes: Brush marks: enso ring + three strokes (abstract, reads as calligraphy at distance, no real kanji). No change after look.
